changes.reason: The interrupted runner buffered both streams in memory and persisted only stdout. V2 streams stdout and stderr directly to distinct exclusive-create files, forwards termination signals, reaps the child, uses a nonblocking advisory lock, fsyncs the append-only ledger, and atomically publishes a recovery checkpoint. The original runner and its ledger remain unchanged.

disclosed_non_scientific_failure.effect: none on formulas, solvers, or verdicts
disclosed_non_scientific_failure.event: A first syntax-check attempt used python -m py_compile and failed before parsing because the managed interpreter tried to create __pycache__ below a sandbox-blocked user cache path.
disclosed_non_scientific_failure.repair: A no-write ast.parse check then passed on the exact v2 bytes.
